feedback: The current candidate shows some progress improvement and a slight reduction in line loss events on the s-bend track, but it still fails to complete either track, with persistent line loss events (1-2 per run) and notable steering oscillations (up to 0.23). The reduction of ki to 0.05 and increase of kd to 0.08 aimed to reduce oscillations and integral windup, and adjusting sensor_weights to increase inner sensor influence was intended to improve line detection. However, the evidence shows only marginal improvement in line loss events and steering oscillation remains relatively high, especially on the s-bend track. The base_speed and kp values remain unchanged, which maintains control responsiveness but may still be too aggressive for stable line following. To further improve completion likelihood and reduce oscillations, I recommend lowering kp slightly to 0.9 to reduce aggressive steering corrections, and further increasing kd to 0.1 for stronger damping. Also, consider slightly increasing ki to 0.07 to balance integral action without causing oscillations. These changes should help stabilize steering, reduce line loss events, and improve track completion. Confirm improvements by monitoring completion, line_loss_events, rms_error, and steering_oscillation in the next race.
